key_points: IBM shares fell ~25% after a weak Q2 and a softer 2026 outlook that investors are still digesting, creating sustained near-term selling pressure.
IBM's own new AI workforce study showing AI erodes critical thinking skills undercuts the company's AI narrative and adds reputational headwinds to its AI business case.
Dividend growth has stalled (recent increase described as 'a penny'), weakening the income-investor thesis despite the 31-year streak.
The comeback case hinges on Red Hat and hybrid cloud reacceleration, which has not yet materialized in results.
Multiple opinion pieces flag valuation and structural concerns, reinforcing negative near-term sentiment even as some argue for longer-term value.
